title: Japanese Buckwheat Pilaf with Slovakian Yeast
description: A unique and flavorful Japanese-inspired pilaf dish made with buckwheat and a hint of Slovakian yeast. Enjoy as a quick and easy side or main course.
instructions: Heat the quaint vegetable oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Slovakian yeast and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the buckwheat and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the pilaf, salt, and water to the saucepan. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the pilaf is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
